name: Split-Stream-FFT
definition: A novel implementation of the Fast Fourier Transform designed to map the recursive structure of the FFT to the stream architecture of a GPU efficiently. It is based on the Decimation-in-Frequency (DIF) approach.
summary: Split-Stream-FFT is a GPU-optimized Fast Fourier Transform implementation that maps recursive Decimation-in-Frequency structures to stream architectures, distinguishing itself by focusing on raw transform computation rather than convolution pipelines.
